name: OptionChip
description:
The one chip used by MultiSelect and TagInput: optional icon, a label that truncates
with a tooltip, and a remove button named "Remove …". Chips are reachable with ← → from
the input; Backspace or Delete removes the focused one.
signature: ({ label, icon, invalid, flash, readOnly, onEdit }: OptionChipProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: flash
props.description: Flash once (an attempt to add it again).

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon. Pass it without a size.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Why this value is not valid: the chip turns danger and the reason is its tooltip.

props.name: label
props.description: The visible or accessible label for this component.

props.name: onEdit
props.description: Enter or double-click edits the chip in place.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Plain text: nothing to focus or remove.
